comments.body: As someone that actually has studied at both universities and actually did the B. Data Science at UNSW I can say that if your goal is to migrate, that’s not going to happen in Australia with that degree. In both situations I would also do a dual degree in Maths + comp sci if your goal is to end up in data science fields. from what I hear from the few ETH undergrads I know is that the coursework is super tough here. STEM at UNSW is not easy, but it’s also a lot more flexible. By the end of my degree I had done roughly a years worth of internships in industries related to data science, but you obviously need to seek those opportunities out yourself, but the degree is flexible enough to accommodate that. Keep in mind that some jobs require Australian citizenship and that international students have a cap of 20hrs of work a week max (you should check this as I was not an international student). Sydney and Zurich are both super expensive to live in as well, but there is a stronger culture of working whilst studying in Australia so you can do that to financially support yourself in Sydney.
comments.author: Gghg625
